strict_rules: NEVER draw procedural stick-figures or polygon-from-scratch character bodies in Python.

ALWAYS generate the 16-bit HD-2D base character sprite (<hero>_v1_base.jpg, 1024x1024, facing +X right on pure #FFFFFF white background, empty hands at sides) and matching bust portrait (portrait_hd2d_<hero>.jpg) using generate_image FIRST.

NEVER pass another champion's base sprite in ImagePaths when generating a new champion's full-body sprite (to avoid copying their armor/silhouette); pass the new champion's own base sprite in ImagePaths when generating their matching portrait.
ALWAYS extract the 52x52 logical base sprite via BFS flood-fill from borders + enclosed white pockets + 3-pass anti-aliased fringe stripping (zero white halo).

NEVER bake a 1px black outline around the character in Python because PixelForge.js (ensureNormalMap + drawSheetFrame) dynamically renders the 1px comic ink outline and 1px exterior rim highlight at runtime.
ALWAYS neutralize baked static side-arms (neutralize_baked_side_arms) before articulating 2-bone IK arms + weapon so there are zero extra limbs or leftover hands.
ALWAYS enforce a 2px transparent safety margin (2 <= x <= 49, 2 <= y <= 49) on all 270 frames (0/270 boundary clips) and run fill_layer_pinholes to prevent 1px interior slits.
ALWAYS generate and visually inspect debug_<hero>_30fps_left_F00_F14.png, debug_<hero>_30fps_right_F15_F29.png, and debug_<hero>_30fps_vfx.png using view_file.
